cases.why: An evocative and precise word for something showy but cheap or shoddy. Its rarity and historical flavor make it interesting rather than useless.
An obvious formation from death. It is mostly a poetic synonym for immortal or undying and does not reward deliberate study.
Although formed from expedient, it is a useful and established word for something impractical or inadvisable.
